topics.name: Signals
topics.description: Discrete-time signals, index transformations, complex numbers, elementary signals (Lectures 1-2, HW1)

topics.name: System properties
topics.description: Linearity, time-invariance, causality, BIBO stability (Lecture 3, HW1-HW2)

topics.name: Convolution
topics.description: Impulse response, convolution, LTI input-output relations (Lecture 4, HW2)

topics.name: z-transform
topics.description: z-transform, ROC, properties, inverse z-transform by partial fractions (Lectures 6-8, HW3-HW4)

topics.name: Transfer functions
topics.description: Transfer functions, LCCDE <-> H(z), system response, improper H, system algebra (Lectures 9-10, HW4)

topics.name: Stability and causality
topics.description: BIBO stability and causality in the z-domain, unbounded outputs (Lecture 11, HW4)

topics.name: DTFT
topics.description: Periodicity, the discrete-time Fourier transform and its properties, inverse DTFTs of ideal spectra (Lectures 13-14, HW5-HW6)

topics.name: Frequency response
topics.description: Frequency response, response to sinusoids, magnitude and phase, group delay (Lectures 15-16, HW6)

topics.name: Sampling and reconstruction
topics.description: Ideal A/D conversion, Nyquist rate, aliasing (Lecture 17); ideal D/A reconstruction and A/D -> H_d -> D/A systems (later lectures)

topics.name: DFT
topics.description: The discrete Fourier transform, its properties, zero padding, spectral analysis, circular convolution (lectures after 17)
